Counsel for Applicant :- Subodh Kumar Pandey,Ramakar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the F.I.R., it was alleged that on 03.04.2024 at about 05:35 am, the wife of the informant had gone to the agricultural field where the applicant committed wrong on her which was seen by the informant.
He stated that he has seen the incident on his own, the age of the victim is around 28 years.

3. sentences.text: He further argued that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 05.04.2024, as such, he may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the overall facts as stated above and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Ram Lakhan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.280 of 2024, under Sections 376, 323 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Sadar, District Lakhimpur Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Saurabh Yadav/-
